title: Resting-State EEG in Parkinson's Disease and Healthy Controls
description: This dataset comprises 358 resting-state EEG recordings from 312 participants with Parkinson's disease and healthy controls, collected under eyes-open conditions. Some participants contributed multiple longitudinal sessions, with accompanying demographic and clinical metadata including MoCA and UPDRS Part III scores, disease duration, and levodopa equivalent daily dose. The dataset was curated and released in BIDS format for public reuse in studying neural correlates of Parkinson's disease.
methods_description: EEG recordings were collected in BrainVision format using eyes-open resting-state conditions, with Pz as the reference electrode. Most recordings were sampled at 500 Hz, with a subset at 25,000 Hz, and contained between 63 and 64 EEG channels plus optional auxiliary channels (e.g., audio, respiratory). Acquisition dates were de-identified while preserving inter-session intervals.
